page-2.title: Who We Are
page-2.content: Who We Are We are established in 2008, specializing in the realm of Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, ICT and Renewable Energy Technologies, covering the spectrum of Design, Shop Drawings and Value Engineering services offerings. We are guided by optimism, using the power of design to inspire a positive change and create a future that promotes wellbeing for all, in line with the latest sustainability trends. We focus on the importance of preserving nature and its resources and encourage our clients to apply any opportunity to reduce the overall impact of the built-up environment on the human health and the natural ecosystem. We are a diverse team, composed of experts in the latest Engineering trends in Renewable Energies, Green Building designs, HVAC Systems technologies, Water Systems efficiencies, Power Generation & Distribution as well as new technologies in IT & Low Current systems. Our aim is to provide Total MEP Integrated Solutions, customized to meet the full spectrum of Engineering services through a constructive cross-discipline collaboration. We invest in innovation, meeting market's expectations, by pushing the boundaries of design through smartly using AEC modeling technologies offering integrated construction models and virtual reality rendering. We are unlocking and creating new tools to release fast innovative solutions serving the construction industry. We promote education within our teams specially in terms of technology and sustainability, through certificates and diplomas acquired from accredited universities and international organizations. We expand our market, by benefiting from the communications technology evolutions, to connect with new clients expanding from the Gulf Countries to North American Countries - mainly Canada. From our side, this expansion enabled us to gain a competitive edge in undersaturated markets, foster our expertise through the diversity of shared opinions and methodologies; from our client's side, this expansion offered them the opportunity to diversify their services, to access additional talents and reduce costs. We come towards our clients, by creating CONSULT EMDC in Dubai, UAE to become an attraction hub for an expanding clientele. The scope of CONSULT EMDC is to proactively recognize and pursue opportunities, cultivate old and new clients' relationships achieving long-term sustainability in the MEP Construction and manage the Business Development, Contracts, Sales and Purchasing activities of both EMDC Group and CONSULT EMDC.

page-4.title: Our BIM Know-How
page-4.content: Our BIM Know-HowWe, at EMDC, enriched our BIM expertise by closely developing BIM models to renown companies, listed in a later section, integrating the MEP Revit materials families from their selected suppliers, their method of statement and showing their installation and fabrication methods in their details and finally submitting a coordinated model as per the presentation technique expected in each company.Finally, as a contribution to the worldwide BIM community, we participated in Autodesk University classes to share our insights about the Automation tools developed in house, automating time-consuming design tasks using Forge and Machine Learning. Both classes are found at the following links:https://www.autodesk.com/autodesk-university/article/Combining-Forge-and-Machine-Learning-Automate-Time-Consuming-Design-Tasks-2021https://www.autodesk.com/autodesk-university/class/Beyond-Dynamo-Powerful-Automation-Potential-Forge-and-Revit-API-2021 The use of BIM is now mandated to ascertain that the planning, design, and construction of projects is a collaborative process with a high-efficiency output. For this purpose, EMDC invested in the BIM world allowing the 3D simulation of the projects before their execution, facilitating visualization and coordination, analyzing and resolving potential clashes, reducing the risk of abortive works on site and finally making more informed decisions.Further to the 3D modeling employed for construction and fabrication, EMDC can offer its clients the essential functionalities of BIM models through BIM 4D to 6D, starting with scheduling tasks, estimating costs and extracting quantities and performing energy analysis.Throughout the projects, EMDC got acquainted with BIM components which play a crucial role in the successful implementation and management of BIM projects, like Common Data Environment (CDE), BIM Execution Plan (BEP), COBie (Construction Operations Building Information Exchange), IFC (Industry Foundation Classes), Asset Information Model (AIM), FM (Facility Management) Integration, GIS (Geographic Information Systems) Integration, 4D and 5D BIM, Virtual Reality (VR) & Augmented Reality (AR) as well as Smart Building Technologies.

Shop Drawings We delivered 10,000 shop drawings within 9 months including client's comment implementation as well as a LOD 400 Revit model and Navisworks model with zero clash for a 250,000 sq.m. mega carpark within 4 months. Moreover, we developed fabrication drawings for projects in Canada, USA and Australia. Value Engineering & Design Review We performed Value Engineering and Design Review tasks on designs made by renown international companies.BIM ProficiencyWe delivered coordinated Revit models using advanced BIM logistics like Navisworks clash tests, MagiCAD and plugins and add-ons.
